purpose: Batch 0 protected-current behavior boundaries. These are regression contracts, not claims that every future implementation or runtime gate is complete.

contracts.owner: DTMAPI.GameBridge.DolocTown custom-animal content bridge plus the owning ContentPack
contracts.architecture: Official JSON plus Content/DTMAPI declarations only for PNG, WAV, template-animation, or reviewed native-adaptation gaps
preservedBehavior: Each package identity, species id, animal-bag id, produce LUT id, animator/document/sound replacement id, sprite prefix, and referenced store/item id remains internally aligned.
Child and adult PNG animation routes render the custom species without replacing a vanilla species globally.
Child and adult WAV replacement is scoped to the matching custom-animal context; vanilla animals with the same native sound event are not polluted.
Missing, stale, or mismatched custom context fails open instead of suppressing or replacing an unrelated vanilla sound.
Enable, disable, removal, title transition, save load, save/reload, and native animal lifecycle preserve or visibly block unsafe state.
A unified future AnimalPack preserves these content identities or supplies an explicit backed-up migration; it never silently renames them.
The new pack plus any enabled old input blocks before safe play; directory enumeration order and new-pack-wins behavior are not compatibility contracts.
separateRoutes: DTMAPI.ShellCrabMod remains a separate AdvancedAssetBundle prototype.
DTMAPI.LightningChickenMod remains retired research and NeverPublish.
forbiddenClaims: The JSON+PNG+WAV route proves AssetBundle unload or Shell Crab lifecycle.
The route implements BGM, looping audio, or a general C# native-spawn API.
Current prototype PNG/WAV provenance is cleared for public redistribution.
Registry or UI success alone proves native save/runtime creation ownership.
releaseGates: Original or explicitly licensed asset inventory with SHA-256 and redistribution scope
Third-save enable, disable, removal, save/reload, native lifecycle, voice, sprite, and vanilla-isolation regression
Focused native-owner review for any new adaptation outside the protected route

contracts.owner: DTMAPI.ZoomMod ProductNative with exact DolocAPI.SetEnvCamera ownership
preservedBehavior: Owns one exact SetEnvCamera Postfix and changes only the world camera orthographic size.
UI scale and click mapping remain untouched.
The product is the only current gameplay consumer; frozen ICameraViewApi and ICameraZoomApi compatibility use a mutually exclusive dormant Host owner.
Save load, returned-to-title, config disable, owner deactivation, and environment-camera boundaries safely restore or reapply the playable view.
Building transitions, map boundaries, camera follow, and native clamps remain native-owned.
outOfScope: Background, panorama, fog, weather, and scanner synchronization
contracts.acceptedLimitation: At enlarged farm view, a smaller centered city/sky background rectangle can leave gray uncovered space. This is accepted and must not be described as background synchronization completion.

lifecycleCases.expected: Reset ProductNative working scale to vanilla; a later player input may apply a new scale.
Restore the captured live playable-camera size and leave no residual enlarged view.

The exact SetEnvCamera Postfix preserves the true baseline when native size still equals the product's last applied value, captures only a genuinely changed native baseline, and reapplies the current ProductNative scale.
Restore vanilla, detach the callback and remove the exact product Harmony owner before reporting disabled.
Restore vanilla and clear product instance, input registrations, callback, exact Hook and Core roots; a live restore failure is explicit even though exact-owner unpatch still runs.

releaseGates: config disable, title and exact-owner cleanup with no residual 4x state

contracts.owner: Self-contained Yuuka.DTMAPI.AutoFishing Advanced ProductNative DLL over Doloc Town fishing native owners

toggle.edgePolicy: Owner-bound pressed edge with a press-release/re-arm guard; title screen does not poll the binding.

sessionPolicy: The SDK-admitted product owns one private fishing session and one canonical Harmony owner.
F6 off removes recurring work and transient native/input/animation state while process-lifetime callbacks fast-return.

Cold disable loads no product assembly or Harmony owner; post-load Manager disable remains restart-required; returned-to-title, save transition, entry failure, and shutdown restore product-owned transient state.
defaultSequence: Show and auto-complete the real minigame

movementCancel.fallback: A/D/Space/Shift snapshots only when the native factor is unavailable
movementCancel.guard: Space/Shift alone are not movement when the native factor is readable

optionIndependence: SkipMiniGame does not acquire a synthetic-input lease.
FastAnimations does not change CastChargeRatio, wait policy, or result policy.
Original animator speeds are restored at state and session boundaries.
compatibility: The old product VerboseLogging config field remains ignored.
The frozen compatibility DTO retains CastChargeRatio.
The retained binary StopOnManualMove setter dependency remains frozen through 0.5.5 even though the new product does not consume IFishingAutomationApi.
releaseGates: Fifth-save real pond fixture; no synthetic pool/cache/wait-state setup as final evidence
native 1x, enabled without acceleration, common acceleration, high multiplier, disable recovery, and title-cycle profiles
movement cancel, options cross-product, cleanup, clean exit, and no Fatal GC

contracts.owner: DTMAPI.MoreSavesMod ProductNative policy over GameManager.archiveFileCount while Doloc Town owns save files and UI lifecycle; ISaveSlotsApi remains frozen Compatibility only
preservedBehavior: The first six slots remain vanilla doloc-archive-{0..5}.data slots.
Slots 7 through 12 can be created, saved, loaded, copied, deleted, and recognized after restart through official owners.
Disabling restores the visible official slot count to 6 and never deletes extra doloc-archive-{n}.data files.
Re-enabling makes intact extra saves available again.
DTMAPI does not claim a MoreSaves-specific save sidecar; LocalSave, DataPersistenceManager, GameDataUiState, and GameDataPanel remain native owners.
evidenceContextOnly: User long-term manual use at 16 slots succeeded in prior experimental API layouts; this is not the current product promise.
acceptedLimitations: An 18-slot single-page overflow was observed and is not promised as supported product behavior.
Arbitrary-count paging, naming polish, and scrolling are future work and do not expand the fixed-12 contract.
releaseGates: Clean exit and no save-file deletion
